abilities.name: Heavy Strike
abilities.description: Deals increased physical damage on an enemy attack.

abilities.name: Enrage
abilities.description: At low health, increases Attack until the encounter ends.

abilities.name: Defensive Stance
abilities.description: Raises Physical Defense for a short time.

abilities.name: Regeneration
abilities.description: Restores a portion of maximum HP when wounded.

abilities.name: Piercing Strike
abilities.description: A physical attack that uses only part of the target's Physical Defense.
